brief_summary: The primary objective of the study is to compare the effect of rosuvastatin therapy plus compliance initiatives and rosuvastatin therapy alone for 12 months (52 weeks) on long-term cumulative direct and indirect disease-related costs during the 36 month.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* high cholesterol with an indication for cholesterol-lowering medication (statins)

Exclusion Criteria:

* contra-indications for statin therapy

official_title: Effects of a Twelve Months ROSUVASTATIN Treatment Plus Additional Care (Drug Intake Adherence and Lifestyle Enhancing Initiatives ) Compared to ROSUVASTATIN Treatment Alone on Long-Term Disease-Related Costs in Patients With an Indication for Statin Treatment According to the Joint European Guidelines

primary_outcomes.measure: Cumulative direct/indirect disease-related costs were compared applying a societal perspective
Costs include resource utilization for ambulatory, hospital, rehabilitative and nursing care, medication, physiotherapy, transportation, and productivity loss)
